- JS off: the button is hidden, 0 animations, 0 of 53 `.reveal` elements at opacity 0. The strip is 162px at 1440 and 74px at 390.

## 2. Pricing plate assembly
- JS on, 1440 and 390: at about 300 ms after load, the `.rect`, `.cover`, and `.toc` parts are running `asmB`, `asmL`, and `asmR`, the same keyframes Home uses (now on `:root` in site-kit.css).
- Resting state: the plate rect is identical to main at 1440 (806.8, 139, 493.2x542.5) and at 390 (20, 591.6, 350x471.4). Every part's geometry is within 0px, the transform is the identity matrix, and opacity is 1.
- Pixel compare of the hero against main: identical with reduced motion and with JS off (bbox None). With JS on there is sub-pixel anti-aliasing on the plate text only (fill `both` keeps the parts on a composited layer with `matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)`). Layout is identical; see shots/pricing-hero-js_on-head-top-main-bottom.png. Not visible at normal viewing.
- Reduced motion and JS off: 0 animations and a settled plate. Nothing is invisible or stuck.
- CLS: 0 on Pricing and 0 on Home (load, scroll, and Pause clicked twice). No horizontal scroll at any width.

## 3. `.reveal` on Pricing, About, and Apply
| page | count | hidden at load (JS on, 1440) | hidden after full scroll | reduced / JS off hidden | page height head = main (1440) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pricing | 15 | 15 | 0 | 0 / 0 | 6159 = 6159 |
| About | 13 | 12 | 0 | 0 / 0 | 4536 = 4536 |
| Apply | 7 | 7 | 0 | 0 / 0 | 3736 = 3736 |
- Full-page screenshots after scrolling through, against main: About and Apply are pixel-identical. On Pricing, the only diff is the plate anti-aliasing above.
- Anchor jumps (1440, 390, 360): `/pricing/#faq`, `/pricing/#pr-faq`, `/about/#ab-proof`, `/apply/#faq`, `/apply/#how-it-works`, and `/apply/#application-form` (the real form anchor; `#form` does not exist on this page). 0 reveals were hidden in view after the jump. 0 were at opacity 0 after a full scroll at 390 and 360 either.
- Hero and form are never reveal-gated: H1, hero Apply, and the form are not in a `.reveal` on any of the three pages or on Home.
  - Time to opacity 1 measured from DOMContentLoaded: Apply page H1 / Apply CTA / form at 35 ms at 1440 and 6 ms at 390 (first poll). Home H1 and hero Apply ("Start with the Growth Blueprint") at 7 ms at 1440 and 12 ms at 390. In other words, they are visible on first paint.

## 4. Dark-band focus rings
- `.on-ink :focus-visible` (Home case cards; Pricing `#pr-terms`; About `#ab-principles`; Services) and `.footer :focus-visible` render `3px solid rgb(250,248,244)` (Paper) with a 3px offset. This holds for all 11 to 15 dark-band and footer links per page at 1440 and 390, and was confirmed by a real Tab into the footer. Paper on Ink is about 17:1.
- Clipping: no `overflow` ancestor clips the ring (body has `overflow-x: clip` only, with full width available).
- The light-band ring is unchanged: `3px solid #8F3520` with a 3px offset.

## 5. Regression (JS on, after scroll and settle; 1440, 768, 390)
- Home, Pricing, About, Apply, Services hub, blog post (`/blog/how-to-evaluate-a-marketing-agency/`), Contact: no horizontal scroll at any width, and 0 console or page errors on head (main is also 0).
- Page heights are equal to main on 17 of 21 page/width pairs. The 4 differences are content drift, not motion:
  - Home 390 is +46 and the blog post is +26 at all widths. In both cases the "latest posts" or related-posts list has different cards: the main preview lists the Oct 5 post "When should you fire your marketing agency…", and the head preview, built Oct 3 from an older branch base, lists the Sep 14 contract-red-flags post. The `#home-latest` section is the only section with a different height. These pages are not touched by the PR's motion changes.

## Should-fix (non-blocking)
1. **Pricing first card is blank at the fold on some desktop sizes.** At 1440x900 the top 83px of `#pr-blueprint .bp-card.reveal` is in view but stays at opacity 0 until the user scrolls. At 1024x768 it is the top 43px. It is fine at 1440x1000, 1280x800, 768, 390, and 360. The cause is the observer's `rootMargin: 0 0 -40px 0` together with the 16px rise. The hidden area is empty cream (no CTA inside), and it reveals on the first scroll. Screenshot: shots/pricing-1440x900-fold-hidden-card.png. Paste-ready options (pick one):
   - Markup: drop the token on the first Pricing card: `src/pricing.njk` `<div class="card bp-card reveal">` becomes `<div class="card bp-card">` (keep it on `.bp-card--engine`).
   - Or CSS: `#pr-blueprint .bp-card.reveal{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:none}`.

## Notes
- JS-on plate anti-aliasing (section 2) is cosmetic. If a pixel-exact resting state is wanted, `fill-mode: backwards` instead of `both` on `asmB`, `asmL`, and `asmR` would drop the composited layer after the animation. That changes the spec'd timing token, so it is optional.
- The PR body's own stale-CSS notes (`direction-b.css` `.logo-marquee`, `styles.css` `.steps--cinematic`) have no runtime effect in these tests.
